reviewer: independent evaluator; did not build or edit R4

criteria.name: Correct identity and source-backed footprint
criteria.evidence: Purdue identification and GIS FID 57; transformed plinth AABB matches under 0.0001 m.
criteria.findings: GIS/local projection is approximate, not survey control; AABB agreement does not verify every wall segment.

criteria.name: Position, orientation, and scale/dimensions
criteria.evidence: Expected local frame and identity asset-root transform persist in the reopened source asset.
criteria.findings: No master-marker placement check; no survey control or verified complete facade heading/dimensions.

criteria.name: Evidence-backed height, floors, and roof form
criteria.evidence: R4 removes 16 unsupported penthouse components, lowers roof edge to 27.72 m, retains roof/parapet/HVAC, documents eight floors per tower, and analyzes 2017–2018 USGS 3DEP returns.
criteria.findings: LiDAR uses class-1 unclassified candidates because no class-6 building returns exist; metadata vertical accuracy is N/A. p95 is 25.93 m and maximum 26.16 m, still below the 27.72 m roof edge; HVAC reaches 28.50 m. Floor count does not resolve floor spacing or exact roof height.

criteria.name: Facade, entrances, and distinctive architecture
criteria.evidence: Purdue official exterior photo supports broad brick, blue-gray glazing, perforated screen, glazed entry, light base, sign, and some rooftop equipment categories.
criteria.findings: Reference is cropped, oblique, undated, unscaled, and direction-unidentified; exact facade positioning, blank elevations, and opening schedule remain unverified.

criteria.name: Modular export, portability, and complete evidence
criteria.evidence: Blender 5.2.3 reopened the expected asset; one direct root/219 children; identity root transform; 10 foliage images packed; relative foliage library resolves; no unresolved unpacked image dependencies; R4 renders and validation present.
criteria.findings: Master integration/placement and as-built interior/circulation are not reviewed or verified.

penthouse_removal_assessment.credit: Removing 16 unsupported rooftop penthouse objects and lowering the tower roof edge from 30.35 m to 27.72 m is a reasonable correction supported by the 2017–2018 surface-return distribution and reduces a previously conspicuous unsupported mass.
penthouse_removal_assessment.caveats: No class-6 building returns were present; roof candidates are class 1 unclassified; the product vertical accuracy is N/A; candidate p95 is 25.93 m and maximum 26.16 m, still below the modeled 27.72 m roof edge; HVAC reaches 28.50 m. These are not surveyed roof/equipment heights.

limitations: Roof/LiDAR evidence is qualitative/approximate because of classification and accuracy limits.
